purpose: Bounded REVIEW_ONLY Trigger-7 audit of the frozen WP719 fresh-turn successor interface, preserving one non-duplicate recovery-semantic falsifier without mutating the active runtime subject.

current_runtime_fence.reason: No executed product discriminator has produced PRODUCT_NEGATIVE evidence. Trigger 4 repaired only the workflow control-plane expression and re-dispatched; semantic successor mutation would risk runtime-subject churn.

static_interface_finding.finding: VoiceHeardResultReentryReceipt binds voiceoutcome_id and voiceoutcome_sha256 but does not carry outcome_kind. project_fresh_turn accepts only the exact predecessor session plus that receipt and does not receive/bind the predecessor VoiceOutcome object. Therefore the fresh-turn boundary cannot itself distinguish RETURNED from INTERRUPTED, ENDED, ERROR or UNKNOWN terminal semantics.
supporting_observations: VoiceOutcome admits RETURNED, INTERRUPTED, ENDED, ERROR and UNKNOWN.
VoicePacketCortex.close_session forwards the caller-supplied admitted outcome_kind while a fully heard result_ref may still be present.
VoiceHeardResultReentryReceipt identity includes outcome id/hash but not outcome kind.
The current WP719 test fixture can construct a structurally valid VoiceHeardResultReentryReceipt directly and does not bind an exact predecessor VoiceOutcome into project_fresh_turn.
FRESH1-FRESH10 exercise reference/idempotence/restart/offline/zero-authority properties but do not discriminate predecessor terminal outcome semantics.
static_interface_finding.epistemic_limit: This is a source-level interface ambiguity, not an executed failure. The local analysis container could not clone GitHub because DNS/network access is unavailable, so no independent executable FRESH11 result is claimed in this delta.

candidate_falsifier.goal: Prove that a normal fresh-turn successor cannot silently treat ERROR/UNKNOWN/other policy-disallowed terminal predecessor outcomes as equivalent to a successful RETURNED predecessor.
minimal_test_matrix: RETURNED + exact completed reentry -> admitted normal fresh successor
ERROR + exact structurally valid completed reentry -> fail closed or route explicit recovery policy
UNKNOWN + exact structurally valid completed reentry -> fail closed or route explicit recovery policy
INTERRUPTED/ENDED -> policy must be explicit and tested; no accidental equivalence to RETURNED
old receipt plus foreign VoiceOutcome -> fail closed if an exact outcome object becomes part of the boundary
minimal_repair_hypotheses_if_falsified: Pass exact predecessor VoiceOutcome into project_fresh_turn and bind its id/hash plus an admitted continuation policy.
Or version the reentry receipt to include outcome_kind as identity-bearing evidence and make fresh successor require an explicit admitted predecessor outcome class.
Do not create a second effect, memory, GWT or outcome authority.
candidate_falsifier.churn_rule: Do not implement this repair on the currently frozen WP719 subject unless the current exact-source runtime discriminator terminates/reconciles or an executed discriminator proves a repair is required. Preserve FRESH11 as REVIEW_ONLY/CANDIDATE_FALSIFIER meanwhile.

external_primary_research_delta.scope: Endpoint/turn-state research only; no new model lane or current mutation request.

This does not supersede the current WP719 recovery/fresh-turn boundary or justify model breadth now.
